entries.source: PANGERL, Goldenkron (=FRA II/37, Wien 1872) S. 159-162, 1380 XI 16
entries.german:
Der päpstliche Auditor Dr. Petrus Gasconis citirt über Klage des Klosters Goldenkron wider das Kapitel der Wyschehrader Kirche wegen Usurpation der in N. CXIII genannten Besitzungen das bezeichnete Capitel vor sein Tribunal.

Petrus Gasconis 1 legum doctor, domini nostri papae capellanus et ipsius sacri palatii apostolici causarum et causae et partibus infrascriptis a domino nostro papa auditor specialiter deputatus universis et singulis abbatibus, prioribus, praepositis, decanis, archidiaconis, thezaurariis, cantoribus, scolasticis, sacristis, canonicis tam cathedralium quam collegiatarum nec non parrochialium ecclesiarum rectoribus, ceterisque presbyteris et capellanis, curatis et non curatis, clericis, notariis et tabellionibus publicis per civitatem et diocesim Pragensem et alias ubilibet constitutis, ad quem vel ad quos praesentes nostrae litterae pervenerint, salutem in domino et mandatis nostris huiusmodi ymo verius apostolicis firmiter obedire! Nuper ex parte sanctissimi in Christo patris et domini nostri domini Urbani divina providentia papae sexti 2 quandam commissionis sive supplicationis cedulam nobis per certum suum cursorem praesentatam, nos tamen ea qua decuit, reverentia noveritis recepisse, cuius tenor sequitur in haec verba videlicet: ,Pater sancte! Lite pendente in palatio causarum apostolico inter venerabiles et religiosos viros dominos abbatem et conventum monasterii Sanctae Coronae Cisterciensis ordinis Pragensis diocesis ex una et dominum Johannem praepositum ecclesiae Wissegradensis prope Pragam 3 de et super nonnullis villis, agris, pascuis, piscariis, silvis, molendinis, possessionibus, iurisdictionibus et rebus aliis et eorum occasione parte ex altera, idem dominus Johannes praepositus per eiusdem sanctam beatitudinem ad ecclesiam Luthomuslensem est promotus et cuidam Wilhelmo 4 de dicta praepositura est provisum, qui dicto Johanni succedens in vitium dictas villas et alia supradicta detinet indebite occupata. Supplicat eiusdem sanctae beatitudini procurator et procuratorio nomine dictorum dominorum abbatis et conventus, quatenus causam et causas, quam et quas dicti domini abbas et conventus movent et movere intendunt contra dictum dominum Wilhelmum novum praepositum necnon decanum, canonicos et capitulum dictae ecclesiae Wissegradensis de et super villis, agris, pascuis, piscariis, silvis, molendinis, possessionibus, iuribus et iurisdictionibus et aliis supradictis et eorum occasione coniunctim et divisim, venerabili viro domino Petro Grasconis dicti sacri palatii causarum auditori, coram quo dicta causa pendet indecisa, committere dignemini audiendas, in statu debito resumendas, decidendas, et fine debito terminandas, cum omnibus et singulis emergentiis, incidentiis, dependentiis et connexis et cum potestate citandi dictos Wilhelmum novum praepositum, decanum, canonicos et capitulum, si opus fuerit, etiam extra Romanam curiam et ad partes semel et pluries totiens quotiens opus erit‘. In fine vero dictae commissionis sive supplicationis cedulae scripta erant alterius manus littera et litterae superiori ipsius cedulae prorsus et omnino dissimili et diversa videlicet haec verba de mandato domini nostri papae: ,Audiat idem magister Petrus Gasconis ut petitur, et iustitiam faciat.‘ Post cuius quidem etc. Finis vero talis fuit: Datum et actum Romae apud sanctum Petrum in palatio causarum apostolico, ubi iura redduntur, supradicto nobis inibi mane hora causarum ad iura reddendum in nostro loco solito pro tribunali sedente, sub anno a nativitate domini millesimo CCC o LXXX o, indictione tertia, die Veneris decima sexta mensis Novembris, pontificatus sanctissimi in Christo patris et domini nostri domini Urbani divina providentia papae sexti praedicti anno tertio, praesentibus discretis viris. magistris Bertholdo de Messchede et Henrico Hugonis clericis Coloniensis et Leodiensis dioceseum; notariis publicis. nostrisque scribis, testibus ad praemissa vocatis specialiter et rogatis.
entries.english:
Papal auditor Dr. Petrus Gasconis, acting on the complaint of the monastery of Goldenkron against the chapter of the Vyšehrad church for usurpation of the possessions listed at no. CXIII, summons the said chapter before his tribunal.

Petrus Gasconis, Doctor of Laws, chaplain of our lord the pope, and auditor specially appointed by our lord the pope in the causes of the sacred apostolic palace and in the case and matter set out below, to all and each abbots, priors, provosts, deans, archdeacons, treasurers, cantors, schoolmasters, sacristans, canons of both cathedral and collegiate churches, as well as parish church rectors, and the other priests and chaplains, with or without a cure of souls, clerics, notaries and public scriveners established throughout the city and diocese of Prague and elsewhere, wherever they may be, to whom or to any of whom these present letters may come: greetings in the Lord, and firmly obey these our mandates, or rather apostolic mandates.

Recently, on behalf of the most holy father in Christ and our lord, Lord Urban VI, pope by divine providence, a certain written commission or petition was presented to us by one of his couriers. You should know that we received it with the reverence due, and its wording follows in these terms: “Holy Father! While a suit is pending in the apostolic court between the venerable and religious lords, the abbot and convent of the Cistercian monastery of the Holy Crown in the diocese of Prague on one side, and Lord Johann, provost of the church of Vyšehrad near Prague, on the other, concerning certain villages, fields, pastures, fisheries, woods, mills, possessions, jurisdictions, and other matters, and matters arising from them, the same Lord Johann, the provost, was promoted by His Holiness to the church of Litomysl, and a certain Wilhelm was provided to that provostship. Succeeding the said Johann in office, this Wilhelm wrongfully holds the said villages and the other things mentioned above in his occupation. The procurator, in the name and on behalf of the said lords, the abbot and convent, petitions His Holiness to deign to commit the cause and causes that the said lords, the abbot and convent, bring or intend to bring jointly and separately against the said Lord Wilhelm, the new provost, and also against the dean, canons, and chapter of the said church of Vyšehrad concerning the above-mentioned villages, fields, pastures, fisheries, woods, mills, possessions, rights, jurisdictions, and other matters and matters arising from them, to the venerable Lord Petrus Grasconis, auditor of the said court of causes, before whom the said case is pending undecided, to hear, resume in due form, decide, and bring to a proper conclusion, with all matters arising, incidental, dependent, or connected, and with authority to summon the said Wilhelm, the new provost, the dean, canons, and chapter, if necessary even outside the Roman Curia and in the regions, once or repeatedly, as often as needed.”

At the end of the said written commission or petition were written, in another hand whose letter or script was wholly and entirely dissimilar to that above, these words by command of our lord the pope: “Let the same Master Petrus Gasconis hear the matter as requested and do justice.” After this, etc. The conclusion was as follows: “Given and enacted at Rome, at St. Peter’s in the apostolic court where justice is rendered, when I, as stated above, was sitting there in the morning at the hour for hearing cases and administering justice, in my usual place as judge, in the year of the Lord’s Nativity 1380, in the third indiction, on Friday, the sixteenth day of November, in the third year of the pontificate of the most holy father in Christ and our lord, Lord Urban VI, pope by divine providence, as aforesaid, in the presence of the discreet masters Berthold von Meschede and Heinrich Hugonis, clerics of the dioceses of Cologne and Liège, public notaries and our scribes, witnesses specially called and requested for the foregoing.”
